quotes.text: What I'd like to do is find the fastest possible route to this being usable, by me, from rex, using the TUI to launch things.
Currently the commands and mini apps don't provide a lot of value. Forinstance, the roadmap. It just prints a json blob of things and isn't actionable in any way.

fields.summary: After milestone 4 landed, the owner asked for the fastest route to Rhiza being usable by them from Rex, launching things from the TUI. The mini apps give little value today: each read app prints its operation's JSON in a scrolling pane, and nothing in them is actionable. The orchestrator proposed making two apps the hub: the roadmap app as a cursor list of milestones and change sets whose selected change set can be opened, planned, shipped, accepted, or its blocking questions answered; and a new inbox app over the existing inbox operation, where questions, sign-offs and failed runs are acted on in place. The other mini apps stay as they are, keeping the many-mini-apps decision. The owner picked 'Roadmap + Inbox' as the first slice and chose to build it through the daemon's ship runs rather than by the orchestrator directly.
fields.title: Milestone 5: Rhiza usable from Rex
